name: Navigate the portfolio and switch its saved theme
description: Checks primary navigation and verifies the chosen appearance survives a reload.
steps: Open the portfolio and choose the light theme
expected: Skills is reachable, navigation indicates the active section, and the light theme remains selected.

name: Validate the contact form on mobile
description: Verifies the small-screen menu works and the contact form validates without claiming to send.
steps: Open the mobile navigation and choose Contact
Enter valid details and submit again
expected: The form reports invalid details, then confirms valid details while stating that delivery is not configured.

name: Review portfolio placeholders and personal photo gallery
description: Checks editable details and confirms the supplied study, portrait, and desk photos appear in the learning gallery.
steps: Review institution and education date fields
Scroll to the personal photo gallery and review its images
Review contact details and skill categories
expected: Project and personal details remain labeled placeholders, skills have no ratings, and the gallery displays the supplied study, portrait, and desk images.
